title: Unreachable config-inferred-type branch and unused recovered_type
description: Inside the `config_kwarg` recovery block, `loaded_config, recovered_type = recovered` is unpacked, then `if not block['explicit_node_type']: node_type = recovered_type`. `block['explicit_node_type']` is set in _find_function_blocks (line 563) to `DECORATOR_TO_NODE_TYPE[decorator_method]`, and `decorator_method` is filtered to be a key of that dict (line 522). Every value in DECORATOR_TO_NODE_TYPE is a non-empty NodeType StrEnum member (all truthy). Therefore `not block['explicit_node_type']` is always False, lines 690-691 never execute, and `recovered_type` is never used. node_type was already initialised to the same explicit_node_type at line 677, so the branch can never change it.
evidence: _find_function_blocks:522 `if decorator_method not in DECORATOR_TO_NODE_TYPE: continue`; line 563 `'explicit_node_type': DECORATOR_TO_NODE_TYPE[decorator_method]`; NodeType members are all non-empty strings (_types.py:32-50). fallback_parse:677 `node_type = block['explicit_node_type']`. So line 690 guard is statically always False.
behavior_preservation: Branch is provably unreachable; removing it (and the unused recovered_type) cannot change behavior.
